title: Indicador revela guinada inesperada nos juros ainda em 2025 | Radar Econômico
content: According to the CME FedWatch tool, which calculates the likelihood of changes in U.S. interest rates from futures market bets, there is a rapid and unexpected shift in expectations for the Federal Reserve. The tool shows an '88%' probability of a 0.25‑percentage‑point cut in the September meeting, a '75%' probability in October, and a '70%' probability in December. These probabilities imply that U.S. rates could end 2025 in the '3.5%–3.75%' range. Analysts say the move should strengthen the dollar’s decline in Brazil and spark discussions about rate cuts in Brazil in 2025.

title: 美联储夜：降息之外的更大变数-外汇频道-和讯网
content: The article discusses expectations for the Federal Reserve’s policy meeting on September 17, 2025, highlighting that markets view the decision as the most significant of the year.  Analysts expect a 25‑basis‑point rate cut, with a 4 % chance of a 50‑basis‑point move, while the Fed’s June dot‑plot median projects 2025 rates at 3.87 %, 2026 at 3.60 % and longer‑term at 3.37 %.  Fed‑funds futures have re‑priced to a 3.60 % rate in December 2023 and 2.88 % by the end of 2026.  Inflation remains a key concern: the latest CPI is 2.9 % YoY, core CPI 3.1 %, Michigan 1‑year expectations 4.8 % and 5‑10‑year expectations 3.9 %, while the St. Louis 5‑year forward rate is only 2.33 %.  The article notes that a rapid or large‑scale easing could “de‑anchor” inflation expectations, raising volatility and boosting demand for gold as a hedge.  Politically, the new Fed governor, Stephen Milan, has been confirmed and has emphasized a “moderate long‑term rate” goal, adding uncertainty to the meeting.  Technical analysis of the USD index shows it trading near the lower Bollinger‑band, with support at 95.52 and 96.37 and resistance at 97.65 and 98.93.  The piece concludes that a dovish stance could lift the dollar to 98.93, while a hawkish stance would keep it near 96.37, and that gold could rally if inflation expectations rise again.  The article quotes officials: ‘追求适度的长期利率’ (pursuing a moderate long‑term rate).

title: FED TOPLANTI TARİHLERİ 2025: ABD Merkez Bankası Fed faiz kararı ne zaman, hangi tarihte açıklanacak? İşte takvim
content: According to the Federal Reserve's 2025 calendar, the next Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting will take place on October 29, 2025. The interest rate decision will be announced on the same day at 21:00 Turkey time, as investors eagerly await the October 2025 FED interest rate announcement. title: La FED recortó la tasa de referencia hasta 4% - Bank Magazine
content: On September 17 2025 the U.S. Federal Reserve released its quarterly projections. It raised its 2025 GDP growth forecast from 1.4 % to 1.6 % and left the unemployment rate unchanged at 4.5 %. Inflation expectations remained unchanged: the PCE price index is projected at 3.0 % YoY and core PCE at 3.1 %. The Fed’s FOMC members signaled two additional 0.25‑percentage‑point cuts in 2025, which would bring the federal funds rate to a 3.50 %–3.75 % range by year‑end, an advance of the cuts that had previously been scheduled for 2026. For 2026 the Fed projects 1.8 % growth, unemployment 4.4 %–4.5 %, and inflation near 2.6 % for both PCE and core. In 2027 it expects another rate cut, higher growth, lower unemployment and lower inflation. Interest‑rate futures confirm at least two cuts before year‑end, aligning with the FOMC’s official projections.

title: FED TOPLANTI TAKVİMİ 2025: Ekim ayı ABD Merkez Bankası Fed faiz kararı ne zaman, hangi tarihte belli olacak, beklentiler ne yönde?

title: Fed corta projeções de juros para 2025, 2026 e 2027
content: The Federal Reserve’s median projections for the Fed Funds rate fell in the short‑term outlook: for 2025 the median estimate dropped from 3.9% in June to 3.6% in September; for 2026 it fell from 3.6% to 3.4%; and for 2027 it fell from 3.4% to 3.1%. The long‑term median projection remained unchanged at 3%, while the 2028 projection was set at 3.1%. On September 17, the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) lowered the Fed Funds rate by 0.25 percentage point, bringing the policy range to 4%–4.25% as expected.

title: 2025 Ekim FED faiz kararı ne zaman açıklanacak? Bir sonraki FED toplantısı ne zaman? FED faiz kararı beklenti tahmini
content: The Federal Reserve (FED) is expected to announce its October 2025 interest rate decision on Wednesday, October 29, 2025, at approximately 21:00 Turkey time. The FED meeting, scheduled for October 28–29, 2025, will be led by Chairman Jerome Powell. The most recent rate decision in November 2024 reduced the policy rate to a range of 4.00%-4.25%. Analysts continue to expect two rate cuts by the end of 2025, despite uncertainty due to limited economic data availability. The New York Fed's Consumer Expectations Survey revealed rising short-term inflation expectations and worsening labor market outlooks. Fed officials remain divided: Stephen Miran reiterated support for continued rate cuts, while Minneapolis Fed President Neel Kashkari warned that a sharp rate cut could risk reigniting inflation. The FED's full 2025 meeting calendar is planned, with the October decision being a key event for global financial markets.

title: Fed Eylül 2025 faiz kararı saat kaçta açıklanacak? Fed faiz indirim beklentisi ne yönde?
content: On 17 September 2025, the U.S. Federal Reserve will announce its September policy rate decision at 20:00 local time. Market participants expect a rate cut, with 90 % of analysts forecasting a reduction. The most likely scenario is a 25‑basis‑point cut, moving the policy rate from the current 4.25 %–4.50 % range to 4.00 %–4.25 %. A larger 50‑basis‑point cut is considered unlikely. If the Fed cuts rates, the dollar could weaken, gold and Bitcoin may rise, and the euro could benefit. If rates stay unchanged, the dollar would strengthen and gold and Bitcoin could face selling pressure. The decision follows falling inflation and a slowing labor market, suggesting the Fed may finally ease policy. As quoted in the article, 'Fed bu kez faiz indirecek' reflects the prevailing sentiment among market observers.

title: Fed Eylül ayı faiz kararı 2025: Fed faiz kararı ne zaman, saat kaçta açıklanacak, beklenti ne yönde?
content: The Federal Reserve’s September 2025 meeting will take place on 16‑17 September, with the policy‑rate decision announced at 21:00 local time on 17 September.  Analysts expect a 25‑basis‑point cut, and a total of three cuts by year‑end.  Inflation data released in August showed a 0.4 % monthly rise and a 2.9 % annual rate, while core CPI rose 0.3 %.  Weekly unemployment‑benefit claims increased, signalling a weakening labour market.  The Fed’s schedule for the year includes additional meetings in November and December.  The article cites IMF spokesperson Julie Kozack’s comments that the Fed has room to lower rates, and notes that former President Donald Trump has pressured the Fed to cut rates.

title: Fed faiz kararı 2025 ekim: Fed faiz kararı ne zaman açıklanacak? Fed faiz kararı beklentisi ne yönde? Fed toplantı takvimi
content: The Federal Reserve's (Fed) October 2025 interest rate decision has become a central focus for the global financial markets. Following the Fed's previous move to cut interest rates, market participants are closely anticipating whether the central bank will continue with a dovish policy, maintain rates, or shift toward a more restrictive stance. The outcome of the decision is expected to generate broad market reactions, influencing global financial conditions, including the U.S. dollar exchange rate and gold prices. The announcement is scheduled for October 9, 2025, at 17:44 (local time), as reported by HABERTURK.COM.
